question: What are added in my monthly bill?
expected_answer: Your bill includes your base plan charge, any add-on packs purchased during the cycle, applicable taxes (GST), and any late payment fees carried over from a previous cycle. A full itemized breakdown is available in the Lauki app under Bill Details.

question: how to see my current data usage?
expected_answer: Open the Lauki app and go to My Account > Usage. Usage updates within a few hours of actual use.

question: do i need to pay an extra charges?
expected_answer: No, Lauki does not charge any convenience fee for payments made through the app, website, or UPI. Payments made in cash at third-party retail outlets may carry a small handling fee set by that retailer,not by Lauki.

question: How to restore my services back?
expected_answer: Pay the outstanding bill in full through the Lauki app, website, or a retail store. Services are typically restored within 30 minutes of a successful payment. If service is not restored after an hour, contact support and reference your payment confirmation ID

question: How much time it will take to refund?
expected_answer: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.Refunds to prepaid account balance (instead of the original payment method) are applied instantly once approved

question: can i go from prepaid to postpaid?
expected_answer: Yes. This requires a short verification process and can take up to 48 hours to complete. Start the request from My Account > Plan > Switch Connection Type in the Lauki app, or visit a Lauki retail store with a valid ID..
